name: Stability Ball Reverse Hyperextension
steps: Lie face down with the ball under your hips and abdomen and both palms on the floor.
Extend your legs behind you and brace your abdomen.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to lift both straight legs smoothly upward behind you until your body forms a straight horizontal line.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower your legs slowly back toward the floor under control.
tips: Stop lifting once your legs align straight with your torso instead of arching sharply into your lower back.
Spread your hands for balance so the ball stays under your hips.
